expected_edit: add v2 Hello and Heartbeat while keeping unversioned ping

files.body:
The planned v2 work will expand the protocol beyond the current ping message with additional message types, explicit versioning, and more robust encoding and decoding behavior. It will preserve compatibility for existing clients where practical, document the wire format and migration expectations, and add broader coverage for valid, invalid, and mixed-version messages.
Shipped: v2 Hello messages with the explicit `v:2|hello:<name>` envelope, while preserving the existing ping message path.
